title: Directionwise normalized cylinder-covering bound
exact_target: If finitely many cylinders $B_i+R$ $u_i$ cover a convex body $K\subset R^{3}$, with unit axes and measurable finite-area perpendicular bases, must $\Sigma _i$ $area(B_i)/area(proj_{u_i\perp }K)\geq \tfrac12 $? No symmetry assumption is imposed and costs have multiplicity.
